name: 2022-23 Makeup - CSE-4303  Linux Programming
subject: Linux Programming

questions.markdown: How user accounts can be created and managed by `useradd`, `usermod` and `userdel` commands?
Write a shell script to reverse a number using while control structure.
Explain the advantages of Linux operating system.

Write the sequence of shell commands to do the following in a sequence.

i) Create a directory by name `newdir`
ii) Change the working directory to `newdir`
iii) Create 3 empty files by name `file1`, `file2` and `file3`
iv) copy `file1` to `file2` and `file3`
v) Delete `file1`

Write the appropriate Vi editor commands to do the following tasks.

i) Exit editor without making changes.
ii) move the cursor one word forward
iii) Scroll the editor one screen down

Write the purpose of following Linux commands.

i) `echo`
ii) `wc`

Write the significance of each of the following options used by `grep` command.

i) `-e` ii) `-i` iii) `-v` iv) `-n` v) `-c`

Write suitable sequence of git commands to

i) To create a directory `mywork` and make it as a repository.
ii) Now create a text file `data.txt` and add content to it and add to repository
iii) Modify `data.txt` by adding some content to it and commit the changes.
Differentiate between absolute and relative method for changing permission with suitable example

Suppose you have been given a large directory containing thousands of files of various types. Your task is to write a script that will find all files with the extension `.txt`, count the number of lines in each file, and output the total number of lines across all files.

Write a script to accomplish this task.

Write the commands for the following tasks

i. To view all currently running processes on a Linux system?
ii. To send a signal to a running process in order to terminate it?
iii. To start a process in the background, allowing the terminal to be used for other commands?

Write an AWK program for the following:

i. To calculate the average of the numbers in the first column of a file, but only for the lines that contain a word “pattern” in the second column. Use a loop to iterate over the lines of the file.
ii. To print the lines of a file in reverse order using a loop to read the lines into an array and then iterating over the array in reverse order.

Write SED editor commands for the following:

i. To replace all occurrences of a word “Happy” in a file with another word “UnHappy”.
ii. To delete all lines in a file that contain a pattern “Sugar”.
iii. To append a new line after a pattern “DESC” in a file.
Analyse any two commonly used commands in Subversion Control.
